question: Should Android chat messages ship the full Copy, Select text, Share, and Reply action set in core once the i18n blockers and real-device proof gap are resolved?
rationale: The linked issue requested the full action set, but this is still new Android product surface with a protected maintainer label and no tap-level proof yet.

options.title: Accept Full Scope After Fixes
options.body: Keep Copy, Select text, Share, and Reply, but require the i18n template cleanup and real Android interaction proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow To Copy And Select
options.body: Limit this PR to the original copy/selection need and defer Share/Reply until maintainers explicitly sponsor that workflow.

options.title: Pause Direction
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and hold this PR until Android chat action scope is decided separately.

recommendation.title: Accept Full Scope After Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep Copy, Select text, Share, and Reply, but require the i18n template cleanup and real Android interaction proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is tied to recent merged Android chat work and authored this implementation branch, making him the best available routing owner for scope and proof decisions.
